虽说返程路上一路畅通，没遇到半点拥堵，但等车子驶入绿城城区时，时间还是过了夜里十二点。

吴姜先将李月芽送回了家，半路上的时候，周姨就打过电话了，知道了他们大概到的时间，下高速的时候，李月芽给妈妈发了微信，周姨是秒回的，不用想也知道，李叔和周姨一直在等着他们，还没有休息。

吴姜停好车，从后备箱拎出一件台子、一条华子，还有一些鹿城当地的特产，和李月芽一起上了楼。

两人刚出了电梯，还没来得及敲门，房门就“咔哒”一声被拉开了，眼神直勾勾地落在李月芽身上，连个眼角余光都没给吴姜。。

“芽芽，可算回来了，累坏了吧？爸爸帮你拿行李！”

李文博连看都没看吴姜一眼，显然还在记恨，这个臭小子把自己的宝贝闺女拐了那么远的事情。

吴姜也不尴尬，嬉皮笑脸地凑上前，把手里的烟酒往李文博面前递了递：“李叔，看我手上，这都是孝敬给您的！”

李文博斜着眼睛瞥了一眼烟酒，鼻子里冷哼一声，嫌弃的模样展露无遗。

李月芽站在一旁，捂着嘴偷偷笑，看着爸爸故意找吴姜的麻烦，半点解围的意思都没有，随手把行李箱塞给爸爸，蹦蹦跳跳地冲进了家门。

吴姜自然是厚着脸皮跟进去了，李叔打小就疼他，跟自己亲爹一样。

李文博黑着脸关上房门，周素兰正从厨房往外端饺子，显然是算计好了他们到家的时间。

“芽芽，小姜，快过来吃吧，刚刚下好，你们应该饿坏了吧！”周素兰笑得眉眼弯弯，把饺子放在餐桌上。

不说还好，一说这个，吴姜的肚子就不争气地“咕咕”叫了起来。

他们晚上在服务区吃过一顿了，但服务区的饭菜，懂得都懂，除了贵，就一无是处了。

他们还特意找了一个看着规模挺大的服务区，但是味道，同样的一言难尽，没吃完，两人就出来了。

吴姜也不客气，拉过椅子，一屁股坐下，拿起筷子就抄了一个饺子塞进嘴里。

“嗯嗯！太香了周姨！周姨的饺子都包的这么好吃，赶明儿一定让我老妈，过来跟您好好学学！”

周素兰被他夸的呵呵直乐，说道：“哈哈，小姜，等你妈来了，这话你敢当着你妈面再说一次吗？”

Although the return journey was smooth and there was no traffic jam at all, by the time the car entered Greentown, it was still past twelve o'clock at night.

Wu Jiang first sent Li Yueya home. On the way, Aunt Zhou called and knew the approximate time of their arrival. When they got off the highway, Li Yueya sent a WeChat message to her mother. Aunt Zhou replied in seconds. It didn't take much to think about it. She knew that Uncle Li and Aunt Zhou had been waiting for them and hadn't rested yet.

Wu Jiang parked the car, took out a table, a flower, and some local specialties from Lucheng from the trunk, and went upstairs with Li Yueya.

As soon as the two of them got out of the elevator, before they had time to knock on the door, the door was opened with a "click", and their eyes fell directly on Li Yueya, not even glancing at Wu Jiang from the corner of his eye..

"Yaya, you're back, are you tired? Dad will help you carry your luggage!"

Li Wenbo didn't even look at Wu Jiang. He was obviously still holding grudges over the fact that this brat had kidnapped his precious daughter so far away.

Wu Jiang was not embarrassed. He stepped forward with a playful smile and handed the cigarettes and wine in his hand to Li Wenbo: "Uncle Li, look at my hands, these are all given to you as a filial piety!"

Li Wenbo glanced sideways at the tobacco and wine, and snorted coldly in his nose, showing his disgust.

Li Yueya stood aside, covering her mouth and laughing secretly. She watched her father deliberately causing trouble for Wu Jiang. She didn't even have the slightest intention of resolving the situation. She just stuffed the suitcase to her father and jumped into the house.

Wu Jiang naturally followed him shamelessly. Uncle Li had loved him since he was a child, just like his own father.

Li Wenbo closed the door with a dark face, and Zhou Sulan was taking dumplings out of the kitchen, obviously calculating the time for them to get home.

"Ya Ya, Xiao Jiang, come over and eat. They've just been cooked. You must be starving!" Zhou Sulan smiled with crooked eyebrows and placed the dumplings on the dining table.

It's okay not to say it. As soon as he said this, Wu Jiang's stomach growled unsatisfactorily.

They had a meal in the service area in the evening, but the food in the service area was understandable. Apart from being expensive, it was useless.

They also specially found a service area that looked quite large, but the taste was also hard to describe. The two of them came out before they finished eating.

Wu Jiang was not polite, pulled up the chair, sat down, picked up the chopsticks, took a dumpling and stuffed it into his mouth.

"Yeah! It's so delicious, Aunt Zhou! Aunt Zhou's dumplings are so delicious. I'll definitely ask my mom to come over and learn from you tomorrow!"

Zhou Sulan was so happy with his praise that she said, "Haha, Xiao Jiang, when your mother comes, do you dare to say this again in front of your mother?"
